title: Lovable Cloud Pricing in 2026 and What a Build Costs
summary: Lovable Cloud pricing uses a credit-based system where the Pro plan's cost depends on your monthly credit allowance, starting at $25.
body_markdown:
## Where Activepieces fits next to a Lovable app


Instead of drawing on your Lovable credits or Cloud usage, recurring backend jobs such as a Slack alert, a CRM sync or a scheduled AI step can run as[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/pricing) workflows, and the free plan includes 1,000 credits a month with unlimited flows.


That keeps the app's meter for what only the app does, and it gives those jobs a separate line in your budget.


### Jobs worth moving out of the app


The test is simple: does the job run on a timer or an event, without a user in the page? If so, it's a candidate.


Every time you ask Lovable to build or revise that logic, you spend credits, and every time it runs inside the app's backend, it can add to the metered Cloud and AI usage.


A job that fires all day, whether or not anyone opens the app, is exactly the kind of load that makes the second line grow without a visible cause.


Below is one such job in Activepieces.


A Stripe "Payment Failed" trigger feeds a Slack "Send Message To A Channel" action, and the run details on the left show the step completed and the run succeeded, at 1 credit for the run however many steps it has.


Two steps, no app code, and nothing to regenerate when the message wording changes, so your team updates messaging without engineering delays. Take from it that this kind of glue's configured on a canvas, not prompted into your app.


Anything a user touches directly belongs in the app: screens, sign-in, and logic that must answer a request in the moment. Moving those out only adds a hop.


### What does the same job cost elsewhere?


To compare cost, set the unit Activepieces meters, 1 credit per run, against your job count rather than against a Lovable plan.


The free plan gives 1,000 credits a month, and Plus is $20 a month for 10,000 credits, as listed at activepieces.com/pricing, which means anyone needing more than 1,000 monthly credits must pay $20 to upgrade.


The right comparison is your own runs per month against those allowances, and past the allowance Plus charges $0.007 a credit, so going over your limit costs $0.007 per overage credit.


This doesn't apply to everything. If a job needs your app's database and auth in the same request, moving it adds a network call and a second system to maintain.


If a workflow runs a model step, the model provider's usage still gets billed somewhere; with your own AI keys on Plus and up, that step is 1 credit and the inference cost lands on your own provider bill.


And a handful of rarely-run jobs may not justify a second tool at all. Count the jobs that fire often and need no user, move those, and leave the rest.
